entries.subject: You reached {realm}!
entries.body: Lu told me. I cried a little. Eat properly. I sent rice balls.

entries.subject: About that wall
entries.body: You've been stuck at {realm} for a while. Open the Breakthrough panel and read each requirement. Every one has a fix.

entries.subject: Welcome to Jade River
entries.body: A small gift for the road.

entries.subject: I drew you!
entries.body: This is you punching a crab. The crab is losing.

entries.subject: Items you couldn't carry
entries.body: These were found where you left them.

entries.subject: A second path
entries.body: One cultivator cannot walk every road.

entries.subject: Your lot: {item}
entries.body: The hammer fell in your favour. Your lot is enclosed, with the Pavilion's compliments.

entries.subject: Your lot: {item}
entries.body: The hammer fell in your favour. The scroll was read to you on the spot, as is the custom; the recipe is yours.

entries.subject: What I owe you
entries.body: I paid the valley what I could. This is for the fisher's child who broke my chains. A man who is paid back remembers how it felt.

entries.subject: I found it myself!
entries.body: You carried me through the Hollow Night so now I carried this up the cliff by myself. Granny Liu says it's a heaven herb. Don't eat it all at once.

entries.subject: About Gu's warehouse
entries.body: You let me walk away, so here is a warning for free. Gu has men waiting in the warehouse rafters. Look up before you go in. These might help.

entries.subject: My brother
entries.body: He threw down his sword and you cut him anyway. I will be on the Caravan Road. Come and try that with me.

entries.subject: We know your name
entries.body: You left our uncle in chains for the Alliance to weigh. The Gu family keeps ledgers too. One day it will be your page we open.

entries.subject: Pests in your bed at {place}
entries.body: Beetles got into your {herb} while you were away. It will live, but it lost half its growth. A pet on Guard duty or a Protection formation would keep them off.

entries.subject: Your {herb} is gone
entries.body: Someone dug up your {herb} at {place} in the night. The bed is bare. Next time leave a pet on Guard duty, or burn a Protection or Concealment formation there.

entries.subject: An Elder's token
entries.body: Word reached the sect that you are a Sage Sovereign. Your token is an Elder's now: at any teleport stone it will call you home, and the sect will not ask for shards. Come home sometimes.
